propositions: Each xdist worker maintains a process-local lru_cache that independently re-renders all 178 corpus bodies (~884 pandoc spawns per worker), causing the same artifact to be computed three times under `-n 3 --dist worksteal` instead of once serially.

The three `test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical` tests each recompute pass-1 renders that are already cached in `_rendered()`, duplicating about half their runtime across the test suite.

Session-scoped cross-worker disk artifacts keyed by SHA-256 digest (corpus JSON, renderer source, pandoc executable) eliminate per-worker cache fills while preserving all 178 corpus bodies and existing assertions.
Sharding artifacts per stratum with PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER-rotated probe order allows concurrent worker fill of different strata rather than serial queueing on a single monolithic artifact.

Mutual exclusion via atomic `os.mkdir` lock directory with 150s fallback deadline ensures one computation per stratum while degrading safely to per-worker renders if a winner crashes, staying within the 300s hang guard.
